familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.restored: See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of tribe of Judah.

familiar.text: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

modern.text: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

original.text: רְאֵ֖ה קָרָ֣אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן אוּרִ֥י בֶן ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: I have filled him with Spirit of Divine, in wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and every craft,

familiar.text: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

modern.text: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,

original.text: וָאֲמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה וּבִתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל מְלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: to devise designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,

familiar.text: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

modern.text: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,

original.text: לַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַחֲשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: in cutting stone for setting and carving wood, to work in every craft.

familiar.text: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

modern.text: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.

original.text: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכָל מְלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: And I, look, I have given with him Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of tribe of Dan, and in heart of every wise-hearted one I have given wisdom; they shall make all that I commanded you:

familiar.text: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

modern.text: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:

original.text: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נָתַ֣תִּי אִתּ֗וֹ אֵ֣ת אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן אֲחִֽיסָמָךְ֙ לְמַטֵּה דָ֔ן וּבְלֵ֥ב כָּל חֲכַם לֵ֖ב נָתַ֣תִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֕וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽךָ

verses.restored: tent of meeting, ark of testimony, cover that is upon it, and all vessels of tent,

familiar.text: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

modern.text: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—

original.text: אֵ֣ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֶת הָֽאָרֹן֙ לָֽעֵדֻ֔ת וְאֶת הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל כְּלֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל

familiar.text: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

familiar.text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

familiar.text: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,

modern.text: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,

original.text: וְאֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַשְּׂרָ֑ד וְאֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן

familiar.text: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

modern.text: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.” The Sign of the Sabbath (Numbers 15:32–36)

original.text: וְאֵ֨ת שֶׁ֧מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֛ה וְאֶת קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים לַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִ֖ךָ יַעֲשֽׂוּ

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses,

verses.restored: And you, speak to children of Israel, saying: Surely my Sabbaths you shall keep, for it is sign between me and you throughout your generations, to know that I, YHWH, sanctify you.

familiar.text: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.

modern.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֞ה דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַ֥ךְ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כִּי֩ א֨וֹת הִ֜וא בֵּינִ֤י וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you; one profaning it shall surely be put to death, for everyone doing work in it, that soul/life shall be cut off from midst of its people.

familiar.text: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

modern.text: Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.

original.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִ֖וא לָכֶ֑ם מְחַֽלְלֶ֨יהָ֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת כִּ֗י כָּל הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה בָהּ֙ מְלָאכָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמֶּֽיהָ

verses.restored: Six days work shall be done, but seventh day is Sabbath of Sabbath-rest, holy to YHWH; everyone doing work on Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

familiar.text: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

modern.text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.

original.text: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֧ת שַׁבָּת֛וֹן קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל הָעֹשֶׂ֧ה מְלָאכָ֛ה בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת

verses.restored: Children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to make/do the Sabbath throughout their generations as age-long covenant.

familiar.text: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

modern.text: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.

original.text: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: It is sign between me and children of Israel into the age; for in six days YHWH made heavens and earth, and on seventh day he ceased and was refreshed.

familiar.text: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

modern.text: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’” Moses Receives the Tablets

original.text: בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ

verses.restored: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave to Moses two tablets of testimony, tablets of stone, written by finger of Divine.

familiar.text: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

modern.text: When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ֙ לְדַבֵּ֤ר אִתּוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֣ת הָעֵדֻ֑ת לֻחֹ֣ת אֶ֔בֶן כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִֽים

translation_notes: Bezalel and Oholiab are called by name; artistry is Spirit-filled wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and craft.
Wise-hearted artisans receive wisdom for making sacred space; craft is not secondary to theology.
Sabbath closes the tabernacle instruction block: even sacred work stops for holy rest.
Severe Sabbath penalties are source-preserved and require ethical/reception audit; do not use for coercive modern practice.
Finger of Divine links tablets to direct Divine inscription.
safety_note: Sabbath is covenant sign and liberation-rest; severe penalty language belongs to ancient covenant enforcement and must not be used for modern violence or coercion. Spirit-filled craft and rest are the governing theological themes here.
